images.alt:
A young boy wearing a Ghostbusters t-shirt is putting jellybean on a fork into his mouth. In front of him is a plate of jellybeans, behind him rows of empty stadium seating. 
📸Jelly bean eating competition, © Christchurch Star, CCL-StarP-01993A.

post.text: It's 1989 and Theo Stewart is at QEII making a world record attempt at the fastest recorded time for eating 100 jelly-beans with a fork (at that time the record was 2 minutes, 24.5 seconds). 1/3
